name: What is the process for cabinet installation, from start to finish?
description: The process involves consultation, measurement, selection, ordering, site preparation, installation, and final inspection.

mainEntity.name: What is the process for cabinet installation, from start to finish?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our cabinet installation process begins with a consultation to discuss your needs and design preferences. Next, we take precise measurements and help you select cabinet styles and materials. Once cabinets are ordered and delivered, our team prepares the space, which may involve removing old cabinets. We then meticulously install the new cabinets, ensuring they are level, secure, and properly aligned. The final step involves inspecting the installation and making any necessary adjustments.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves consultation, measurement, selection, ordering, site preparation, installation, and final inspection.
